boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-purchase activities for St. Mary’s students, from campus waterfront equipment to complimentary historic-site access.

cards.title: Paddle a campus kayak
cards.subtitle: The Waterfront, St. Mary’s College of Maryland
cards.notes: Bring your student ID to check out a kayak, then launch from the Waterfront and paddle the St. Mary’s River with a friend.
cards.short_summary: Use the college’s free daily kayak access for a self-paced river outing.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM states that students have free daily access to kayaks for recreational use at the Waterfront.
cards.access_notes: For SMCM students; bring student ID to check out waterfront equipment. Follow current Waterfront procedures.

cards.title: Try a stand-up paddleboard
cards.subtitle: The Waterfront, St. Mary’s College of Maryland
cards.notes: Check out a stand-up paddleboard with your student ID and stay close to shore while you get comfortable on the St. Mary’s River.
cards.short_summary: A no-purchase paddleboard session using student equipment access.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM states that students have free daily access to stand-up paddleboards for recreational use at the Waterfront.
cards.access_notes: For SMCM students; bring student ID to check out waterfront equipment. Use equipment only under current Waterfront guidance.

cards.title: Rig up for windsurfing
cards.subtitle: The Waterfront, St. Mary’s College of Maryland
cards.notes: Ask about current equipment procedures, use your student ID for checkout, and choose conditions that match your windsurfing experience.
cards.short_summary: Student-access windsurfing equipment makes this a no-purchase waterfront activity.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM states that students have free daily access to windsurfing equipment for their own recreational use.
cards.access_notes: For SMCM students; bring student ID to check out waterfront equipment. Confirm conditions and current instructions before launching.

cards.title: Sail an FJ boat
cards.subtitle: The Waterfront, St. Mary’s College of Maryland
cards.notes: Use free daily student access to an FJ sailboat, checking local conditions and the Waterfront’s current checkout instructions first.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus sail session using FJ boats available to students at no purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM states that students have free daily access to FJ sailboats for their own recreational use.
cards.access_notes: For SMCM students; bring student ID to check out waterfront equipment. Follow current safety and qualification requirements.

cards.title: Catch a free weekend movie
cards.subtitle: Cole Cinema, Campus Center
cards.notes: Check the campus schedule, then meet inside the Campus Center for a weekend film without buying a ticket.
cards.short_summary: Campus Life identifies free weekend movies at Cole Cinema.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM’s Campus Life page says students can catch free movies at Cole Cinema every weekend.
cards.access_notes: Free movies are described for students; verify the current campus event schedule and screening details before going.

cards.title: Attend a Cinema lecture
cards.subtitle: Cole Cinema, Campus Center
cards.notes: Watch for a professor or guest-speaker event, then arrive via the Campus Center Information Desk hallway for a no-charge program.
cards.short_summary: Cole Cinema hosts free student lectures alongside film screenings.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM says Cole Cinema hosts events free of charge to students, including lectures by professors and guest speakers.
cards.access_notes: Free to SMCM students when a qualifying event is scheduled; check the event listing for date, capacity, and any registration.

cards.entity_name: Historic St. Mary’s City Exhibit Visit
cards.title: Explore Historic St. Mary’s City
cards.subtitle: Historic St. Mary’s City exhibit areas
cards.notes: Get the student complimentary ticket, then use it to explore the site’s exhibits, reconstructed buildings, and staff interpretation.
cards.short_summary: SMCM students receive complimentary admission tickets to the historic site’s exhibit areas.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM states that St. Mary’s College students receive complimentary admission tickets to all Historic St. Mary’s City exhibit areas.
cards.access_notes: For SMCM students using complimentary tickets; obtain the current ticket and confirm exhibit availability before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Historic St. Mary’s City Interpretive Gardens
cards.title: Walk the interpretive gardens
cards.subtitle: Historic St. Mary’s City grounds
cards.notes: During the winter closure of living-history sites, walk the interpretive and Bayscape gardens and read the on-site signage together.
cards.short_summary: The museum welcomes visitors to these grounds without an admission fee during winter closure.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic St. Mary’s City says visitors may enjoy its interpretive and Bayscape gardens and signage while living-history sites are closed in winter, with no admission fee.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Historic St. Mary’s City
cards.access_notes: No admission fee is documented while living-history sites are closed in winter; confirm seasonal site status before travel.

cards.entity_name: Historic St. Mary’s City Walking Trails
cards.title: Take the museum-property trails
cards.subtitle: Historic St. Mary’s City trail network
cards.notes: Start with the available trail information, choose a route suited to your group, and use daylight hours for a walk around museum property.
cards.short_summary: Historic St. Mary’s City identifies hiking and walking trails available throughout its property.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic St. Mary’s City says hiking and walking trails are available throughout the museum property anytime; its winter grounds access carries no admission fee.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Historic St. Mary’s City
cards.access_notes: The source documents trails anytime and no-fee winter grounds access; confirm whether your planned route is within no-admission winter access.

cards.title: Meet for laps on the track
cards.subtitle: St. Mary’s College of Maryland running track
cards.notes: Bring your student ID, pick an open time outside classes or athletic events, and set an easy lap or walking goal together.
cards.short_summary: The campus running track is listed among recreation facilities available to students.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM lists a campus running track among facilities available to students and says recreation facilities are generally available on demand except during classes, athletic events, or special activities.
cards.source_title: Campus Resources & Services – Office of Residence Life | SMCM
cards.access_notes: For SMCM students. Facilities are generally available on demand except during physical-education classes, athletic events, or special activities; bring student ID.
